title: Allowed response: service_call
description: One entry in a prompt's allowed_responses list that represents a call to a registered service.

id.description: Stable identifier within this prompt's allowed_responses (e.g., 'call-postgres-get-users').

service.description: Name of a service declared in this prompt's `services` list.

request_schema_ref.description: Relative path within the bundle to the JSON Schema for the request payload (e.g., 'service-schemas/postgresql-service.json#/tools/get_users/inputSchema').
